title: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Juicy, tender chicken marinated in a sweet-savoury teriyaki sauce — quick stovetop method for weeknights.

ingredients.notes: or thighs, flattened to 2 cm thick

method.instruction: Flatten chicken to about 2 cm thick for even cooking. Place in a bowl or zipper bag for marinating.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a bowl. Stir until sugar dissolves.
Pour half the marinade over the chicken and set aside the remaining half for glazing. Marinate chicken for at least 1 hour in the refrigerator, or up to overnight.
Heat vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Remove chicken from marinade and wipe off excess. Cook for 5–6 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
During the last 2–3 minutes, brush the reserved marinade over the chicken. It will reduce into a glossy glaze.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2 minutes. Slice against the grain.
Serve over steamed rice, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and spoon any remaining glaze over the top.

notes.title: Marinating Time
notes.content: Minimum 1 hour marinating is recommended. Overnight gives the deepest flavour. The sugar in the marinade helps caramelise the chicken during cooking.

notes.title: Grill or Bake
notes.content: This also works on a hot grill or baked at 200°C for approximately 20 minutes. Brush reserved marinade during the last 5 minutes to create the glaze.
